hadith:
Patients - Narrated `Aisha:

Whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) paid a visit to a patient, or a patient was brought to him, he used to invoke Allah, saying, "Take away the disease, O the Lord of the people! Cure him as You are the One Who cures. There is no cure but Yours, a cure that leaves no disease."
message: Allah is incomparable, and Al-Majeed is worthy of our praise and gratitude. When illness comes, ask Him for healing, for He is the One who cures.
name:
Al Majeed - الْمَجِيدُ - The All-Glorious

Al Majeed expresses Allah's perfect glory, nobility and generosity. His greatness inspires praise and His bounty calls forth gratitude. This name invites His servants to honour Him in worship and reflect on His abundant goodness.
verse:
Al-Ikhlas - The Sincerity - 112:4

And there is none comparable to Him.”
